what: Llama 3.1 Nemotron Safety Guard 8B v3: item-by-item agreement of every pair of runs the volume holds. Descriptive: no pass, no fail, no threshold.
written_before: the first computation of the pairs below, except the four named under already_seen
files: per arm and track, the whole per-item file of the 16-concurrent cell: input_c16.jsonl (prompts) and output_c16.jsonl (responses)
pairs: every two of the arms, none left out; an arm whose file is missing is listed as missing and its pairs are not computed

groups.UU: upstream vLLM 0.20.2 against upstream vLLM 0.20.2 (another day or another container)
groups.N2: the generic NIM 2.0.12 against upstream vLLM 0.20.2
groups.N1: the model's own NIM 1.14.0 against upstream vLLM 0.20.2
groups.other: every other pair (a NIM against itself or the other NIM, another version of upstream vLLM)

counted.agreement: as criterion C3 of the second look: over the items present in both files, the share with the same verdict field
counted.differing: items present in both files minus those with the same verdict field
counted.direction: over the items on which both runs gave a verdict: unsafe only in the first, unsafe only in the second

reported: every pair; per group and track the smallest and the largest share and the smallest and the largest number of differing items

reading_decided_beforehand.N2's range on each track lies inside UU': the article says the NIM disagreed with upstream about as often as upstream disagreed with itself
reading_decided_beforehand.N2's whole range on a track lies below U: the figures are given as they are, the track is named, and the article says so in other words
reading_decided_beforehand.an arm of N1 has no per-item file: its pairs are listed as missing

already_seen.note: these four were computed as parts of two pre-registered cells; the other pairs had not been computed when this was written
